verdict.rationale: Stripe Connect documents agent-usable surfaces: an official MCP server, an official CLI, llms.txt and markdown docs. It also documents an API call to retrieve a connected account's balance and support for managing connected-account payouts, which covers reading balances and payouts. Disputes are documented only as viewable in the Dashboard, and nothing covers investigating a missing payout or drafting dispute evidence through an API or agent surface; the OpenAPI probe also returned 404. Missing for 10: documented API/MCP surface for drafting or submitting dispute evidence, a missing-payout investigation workflow, a reachable OpenAPI spec, and hands-on or independent corroboration of agent use for these money tasks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can work the money side — read balances and payouts, investigate a seller's missing payout, draft dispute evidence — against documented, agent-usable surfaces

citations.quote: To check the balance of a connected account, perform a retrieve balance call authenticated as the connected account.
Pay out to connected accounts: Manage payouts and external accounts for your connected accounts.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.stripe.com/mcp
You can view all disputes filed against your platform and connected accounts in your Dashboard.
